description: Edits a client; fields left out keep their value. changes: { client_secret?, allow_all_return_urls?, redirect_uris?, allowed_scopes?, exposed_scopes?, access_token_audience? }.

changes.description: The fields to change. A client (an app that signs in, or an API). On edit, fields left out keep their value.

access_token_audience.description: Audience value used when the requesting client's request has no resource and no resource-qualified scope; the client id when not set. On a Generic configuration an absolute URI here, e.g. https://weather.example/mcp, is also an accepted resource parameter value (RFC 8707), which then becomes aud (see the audience rule).

allow_all_return_urls.description: Accept any redirect URI. Convenient for local tests; default false.

allowed_scopes.description: Scopes the client may request, e.g. openid, profile, email, offline_access, api://orders/read. Default when adding: openid, profile.

client_id.description: The client id. Required when adding; fixed afterwards (it is the id in the URL when editing).

client_secret.description: The client secret; checked only when the configuration's validate_client_secrets setting is on.

exposed_scopes.description: Scopes this client exposes as an API (resource), e.g. https://weather.example/mcp/tools.read: advertised in discovery scopes_supported. On a Generic configuration each scope's resource (everything before the last /) is an accepted resource parameter value (RFC 8707), which then becomes aud (see the audience rule).

redirect_uris.description: Exact redirect URIs the app uses, e.g. http://localhost:5173/callback (http(s) with a host, or an app scheme such as com.example.app:/callback or myapp://callback).

client_id.description: The id of the client to edit.

configuration_id.description: The configuration id (from create_tenant or get_tenant).

name: edit_client
